title: Checkout Optimization
meta: Fewer steps, clearer costs and faster payment options at checkout, so more shoppers finish. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: We go through your checkout from the cart to the confirmation email and note every step that makes a shopper hesitate. Then we fix what your platform allows: guest checkout, field order, shipping and tax shown early, express payment buttons, clear error messages and a visible order summary. You get a before and after list of changes and a test order record, so you can see what moved.

faq: Can you edit checkout on any platform?
It depends on the platform. Shopify limits checkout edits on some plans, while WooCommerce and BigCommerce allow more. We tell you what is possible on your plan before we start.
Will you change my payment provider?
Only if you ask. We usually work with your existing provider, and we can add express options such as wallet buttons that your provider already supports.
Do test orders cost me money?
Test orders use the provider's test mode or a discount code at zero cost where possible. If a real small order is needed, we ask you first and refund it straight away.
Do I need to give you card or bank details?
Never. We do not need payment credentials or customer card data. We work as staff in your store and check settings only.
